z-m-12-11.title: Akwatin da aka rufe A ne ko B?
z-m-12-11.topic: Yi hasashen yiwuwar faruwa daga sakamakon gwaji.
z-m-12-11.goal: Duk lokacin da adadin ƙwallan da aka zana ya ƙaru, sake duba hukunci da amincewarka ko akwatin A ne ko B, ka bayyana cewa idan sakamakon bai dace da kowace jaka da kyau ba, za ka iya yin shakku da zato na farko.
z-m-12-11.material: Akwatuna A da B kowanne yana da ƙwallaye 10 masu girma iri ɗaya. A yana da ja 3 da shuɗi 7, B kuma ja 7 da shuɗi 3. Malami ya zaɓi ɗaya daga cikin akwatunan ya rufe. Ana maimaita haka: a ɗauki ƙwallo guda daga akwatin da aka rufe, a duba launinta, a mayar, a gauraya. Kowace ƙwallo tana da yiwuwar zane iri ɗaya.
z-m-12-11.thinking.0: Yanke hukunci ta kwatanta sakamakon gwaji da yawan da ake tsammani.
z-m-12-11.thinking.1: Sake duba amincewa yayin da yawan gwaje-gwaje ke ƙaruwa.
z-m-12-11.thinking.2: Yi shakku da zato idan sakamakon bai dace da shi ba.
z-m-12-11.prereq.1: Hasashen cewa launin da yake da ƙwallaye da yawa zai fi fitowa, da iyakokinsa.
z-m-12-11.s.s1.prompt: Yayin da ake ƙara zana ƙwallo, sakamakon yana bayyana ɗaya bayan ɗaya. Kowace rana zaɓi akwatin da ya fi yiwuwa.
z-m-12-11.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowane akwati, rubuta bambancin yawan da ake tsammani da ainihin adadin gefe da gefe.
z-m-12-11.s.s1.hint.1: A kowane mataki, kwatanta ko bambancin yana nan babba ko yana raguwa yayin da yawan gwaje-gwaje ke ƙaruwa.
z-m-12-11.s.s1.st.0.info: Bayan zane sau 10, ja ta fito sau 6, shuɗi sau 4. (Idan A ne, ja zai fito kusan sau 3 cikin 10; idan B ne, kusan sau 7.)
z-m-12-11.s.s1.st.0.ask: Wane akwati ne ya fi yiwuwa aka rufe?
z-m-12-11.s.s1.st.0.after: Sau 6 ya fi kusa da kusan sau 7 da B zai bayar fiye da kusan sau 3 na A. Amma ja na iya fitowa sau 6 daga A ma (da wuya), kuma gwaje-gwaje 10 kaɗan ne don tabbatarwa.
z-m-12-11.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Wataƙila A ne, amma ba tabbas ba.
z-m-12-11.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ba ka lura cewa samun ja sau 6 daga akwati mai ja 3 kawai ya fi wahala da A fiye da B ba.
z-m-12-11.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Wataƙila B ne, amma ba tabbas ba tukuna.
z-m-12-11.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wannan ra'ayi ne da ya yi la'akari da cewa sakamakon ya kusa da na B da kuma cewa gwaje-gwajen kaɗan ne.
z-m-12-11.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Tabbas B ne. Sau 6 cikin 10 kusan daidai yake da na B.
z-m-12-11.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ka yanke hukunci daga gwaje-gwaje 10 kawai. Ja na iya fitowa sau 6 daga A ma.
z-m-12-11.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Yiwuwar A da B iri ɗaya ce, saboda haka ba za mu iya bambanta su ba.
z-m-12-11.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Ba ka lissafa ko 6 ya fi kusa da 3 ko 7 ba.
z-m-12-11.s.s1.st.1.info: Ka zana ƙwallaye 30 ƙari, jimilla zane 40 ne, ja kuma ya fito sau 22 gaba ɗaya. (Idan A ne, kusan sau 12 cikin 40; idan B ne kusan sau 28.)
z-m-12-11.s.s1.st.1.after: 22 yana da nisa 10 daga kusan 12 na A, nisa 6 kuma daga kusan 28 na B, saboda haka ya fi kusa da B. Hasashenka na B ya ƙara ƙarfi idan aka kwatanta da farko, amma yana damunka cewa ya gaza 28 da 6.
z-m-12-11.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Canza zuwa A. 22 ya gaza 28 da B zai bayar.
z-m-12-11.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ba ka lura cewa 22 ya fi kusa da kusan 28 na B fiye da kusan 12 na A ba.
z-m-12-11.s.s1.st.1.o.b: 22 cikin 40 kusan rabin ne, saboda haka A da B daidai suke yiwuwa.
z-m-12-11.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ka ga yana kusa da rabi (sau 20) kawai, ba ka lissafa ko ya fi kusa da kusan 12 ko 28 ba.
z-m-12-11.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Har yanzu B ne. 22 ya fi kusa da kusan 28 fiye da kusan 12.
z-m-12-11.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wannan ra'ayi ne da ya ci gaba da hukuncin, yana kwatanta da adadin da ake tsammani ko da yawan gwaje-gwaje ya ƙaru.
z-m-12-11.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Sakamakon yana canzawa kowane lokaci da yawan gwaje-gwaje ya ƙaru, saboda haka ba za mu iya cewa ɗaya ba.
z-m-12-11.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Abu ne na al'ada sakamakon ya ɗan canza. Duk da haka za ka iya faɗin wanne ya fi kusa.
z-m-12-11.s.s1.st.2.info: An zana sau 100 gaba ɗaya, ja ya fito sau 55. (Idan A ne, kusan sau 30 cikin 100; idan B ne kusan sau 70.)
z-m-12-11.s.s1.st.2.after: Gwaje-gwaje 100 adadi ne mai yawa, don haka yana da wuya a bayyana ta sa'a kaɗai. 55 ya fi kusa da kusan 70 na B fiye da kusan 30 na A, amma ya bambanta sosai da duka biyun. A irin wannan hali ya kamata a yi shakku da yarjejeniyar cewa 'ɗaya daga cikin biyun' ce, ko hanyar zana ƙwallo (ko ana mayarwa da gaurayawa).
z-m-12-11.s.s1.st.2.o.a: B ne. 55 ya fi kusa da kusan 70 na B fiye da kusan 30 na A, saboda haka babu buƙatar ƙarin bincike.
z-m-12-11.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ka duba wanne ya fi kusa kawai, ba ka lura cewa ya yi nisa sosai daga akwatunan biyun ba.
z-m-12-11.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Da farko duba ko akwatin da gaske A ne ko B, ko kuma an gauraya ƙwallayen yadda ya kamata yayin zane.
z-m-12-11.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wannan ra'ayi ne cewa idan sakamakon bai dace da ɗaya daga cikin zaɓuɓɓukan biyu ba, za a iya bincika yarjejeniyoyin asali (adadin ƙwallaye a akwatin, hanyar zane).
z-m-12-11.s.s1.st.2.o.c: 55 kusan tsakiyar 30 da 70 ne, saboda haka A da B rabin-rabi ne.
z-m-12-11.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Kasancewa a tsakiya na iya nuna bai dace da kowace jaka ba. Ba hujja ba ce ta rabin-rabi.
z-m-12-11.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Ya fi kusa da B, amma ya gaza kusan 70 da 15, saboda haka a duba hanyar.
z-m-12-11.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Wannan ra'ayi ne da ya riƙe hasashen B amma ya duba hanya saboda sakamakon ya bambanta sosai da abin da ake tsammani.
z-m-12-11.s.s1.reflect: Da farko ka karkata ga B, a mataki na biyu hasashen ya ɗan ƙarfafa, a mataki na uku kuma ka sake duba zatonta na 'ɗaya daga cikin biyun'. Yayin da yawan gwaje-gwaje ke ƙaruwa amincewa na iya ƙaruwa, amma zato ma na iya girgiza. Ka tuna lokacin da hukunci da amincewarka suka canza da yadda suka canza.
z-m-12-11.s.s2.prompt: Rubuta cewa yawan ƙwallan da ka zana yana ƙara amincewa, da kuma cewa duk da haka ba za ka ce tabbas ba.
z-m-12-11.s.s2.hint.0: Duba yadda amincewarka ta canza a zane sau 10, 40, 100.
z-m-12-11.s.s2.hint.1: Nemo wane ɓangare na sakamakon ƙarshe A ko B ba su bayyana ba.

z-m-12-11.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka rubuta dalilan da ba za a tabbatar ba ko da gwaje-gwaje da yawa ne (sa'a, zato, hanya)?
z-m-12-11.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ka haɗa abin da ya dame ka a sakamakon zane 100?

z-m-12-11.s.s2.model.2: Yayin da aka kai zane 10, 40, 100 amincewar cewa B ne ta ƙaru, amma 55 cikin 100 ma ya bambanta da kusan 70 na B, saboda haka ba za mu ce tabbas ba.

z-m-12-07.title: 1 m² nawa ne cm²?
z-m-12-07.topic: Alaƙar ma’aunin fili m² da cm²
z-m-12-07.goal: Fahimtar dalilin da ya sa ba za a iya miƙa alaƙar ma’aunin tsawo (1 m=100 cm) kai tsaye zuwa ma’aunin fili ba, ƙirƙiri murabba’ai masu fili 1 m² da dama ta amfani da cm, sannan ka bayyana wa ƙani ya fahimta.
z-m-12-07.material: Ajin Jiho yana son yin wurin karatu mai fili daidai 1 m² a gefe ɗaya na aji. Jiho ya ce, ‘1 m yana da 100 cm, saboda haka 1 m² yana da 100 cm².’ Ƙaninsa Harin mai aji na 3 ta ji ta rikice. Ma’aunin tsawo cm da m ne, ma’aunin fili kuma cm² da m². (Ana karanta cm² ‘murabba’in santimita’, m² kuma ‘murabba’in mita’.)
z-m-12-07.thinking.0: Gano kuskuren miƙa alaƙar tsawo kai tsaye zuwa fili
z-m-12-07.thinking.1: Ƙirƙiri murabba’ai da dama da suka cika sharudda
z-m-12-07.prereq.0: Gano filin murabba’ai da murabba’i (aji na 4)
z-m-12-07.prereq.1: Alaƙar ma’aunin tsawo cm da m
z-m-12-07.prereq.2: Ma’anar ma’aunin fili cm² da m²
z-m-12-07.s.s1.prompt: Jiho ta warware kamar haka tana tunanin murabba’i mai gefe 1 m. Zaɓi layi guda da ba daidai ba.
z-m-12-07.s.s1.hint.0: Alama ga kowane layi ko yana magana ne game da ‘tsawo’ ko ‘fili’.
z-m-12-07.s.s1.hint.1: Gano filin murabba’i mai gefe 100 cm da cm kai tsaye, sannan ka kwatanta da ƙarshe a mafita.
z-m-12-07.s.s1.line.0: Yi tunanin wurin murabba’i mai gefe 1 m.
z-m-12-07.s.s1.line.2: Filin murabba’i shi ne (gefe)×(gefe), don haka 1 m × 1 m=1 m².
z-m-12-07.s.s1.line.3: 1 m=100 cm, saboda haka 1 m²=100 cm².
z-m-12-07.s.s1.explain: Layi na 4 ne ba daidai ba. Ga tsawo, 1 m=100 cm; amma ga fili, 100 cm×100 cm=10000 cm². 100 cm² fili ne na murabba’i mai gefen 10 cm kawai.
z-m-12-07.s.s2.prompt: Kana son yin wurin karatu murabba’i mai fili daidai 1 m². Tantance faɗi da tsawo a cm ka shigar. Faɗi da tsawo duk lambobi cikakku ne daga 40 cm zuwa 250 cm; musayar faɗi da tsawo siffa ɗaya ce, saboda haka ƙirga sau ɗaya. Nemo siffofi 3 daban-daban.
z-m-12-07.s.s2.hint.0: Zaɓi faɗi, sannan ka yi tunanin tsawon da ake buƙata don faɗi × tsawo ya zama 1 m², ka sauya zuwa m.
z-m-12-07.s.s2.hint.1: Ga ma’auratan da ka samu, rubuta samfurin faɗi da tsawo ka tabbatar duka iri ɗaya ne.
z-m-12-07.s.s2.fail.c1: Shigar da faɗi da tsawo a matsayin lambobi na halitta.
z-m-12-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Yana aƙalla 40 cm kuma bai wuce 250 cm ba.
z-m-12-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Faɗi da tsawo dole su kasance aƙalla 40 cm amma ba fiye da 250 cm ba.
z-m-12-07.s.s2.fail.c3: Fili ba 1 m² ba ne. Sauya faɗi da tsawo zuwa m sannan ka ninka su.
z-m-12-07.s.s2.explain: Idan faɗin ƙasa 1 m² ne, ya zama 10000 cm². 100×100, 50×200, 80×125, da 40×250 duk sun cika sharudda (musayar faɗi da tsawo siffa ɗaya ce). Waɗannan ma’aurata ne da samfurin faɗi da tsawo 10000 ne.
z-m-12-07.s.s3.prompt: Bayyana wa Harin da sauƙi dalilin da ya sa 1 m² yake 10000 cm², ba 100 cm² ba. Ta san ninkawa da grid na cm, amma sabuwa ce a ma’aunin fili. Yana da kyau ka rubuta kamar kana zana hoto da kalmomi.
z-m-12-07.s.s3.hint.0: Ka fara da faɗin abin da Harin ta riga ta sani (ninkawa, murabba’ai 1 cm).
z-m-12-07.s.s3.hint.1: Yi tunanin cika murabba’i mai gefe 1 m da murabba’ai 1 cm, ka ƙirga nawa ke shiga a layi guda da yawan layuka.
z-m-12-07.s.s3.placeholder: Misali, Harin, murabba’i mai gefe 1 m ...
z-m-12-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Shin ka bayyana kalmomin da Harin ba ta sani ba (ma’aunin fili)?
z-m-12-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Shin ka nuna dalilin 10000 da hoto kamar ‘murabba’ai 100 × layuka 100’?
z-m-12-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Shin ka faɗi wane murabba’i fili 100 cm² na Jiho yake nufi (idan ana so)?
z-m-12-07.s.s3.model.0: Harin, murabba’i mai gefe 1 m yana da gefuna 100 cm. Ka yi tunanin cika shi da ƙananan murabba’ai 1 cm gaba ɗaya. Murabba’ai 100 ne a faɗi, akwai layuka 100 makamantan haka a tsayi. Saboda haka 100×100=10000 murabba’ai ne, don haka 1 m² =10000 cm².
z-m-12-07.s.s3.model.1: Harin, yi tunanin rufe babban takarda 1 m² da ƙananan takardu masu launi 1 cm² kowanne. Guda 100 suna shiga a layi ɗaya, layuka makamantan haka kuma 100 ne. Guda 100 a kowane layi na layuka 100 jimilla guda 10000 ne, saboda haka 1 m² 10000 cm² ne.
z-m-12-07.s.s3.model.2: Fili na murabba’i mai faɗin 100 cm da tsayin 100 cm shi ne 100×100=10000 cm². Ko da kowane tsayi ya ninka sau 100, faɗi da tsayi duk sun ninka sau 100, saboda haka fili ya ninka sau 100×100.

z-m-12-02.title: Za mu iya amincewa da hanyar sauƙaƙe ta Seoa?
z-m-12-02.topic: Yin kasrori masu girma ɗaya da ƙa'idar rage kasro.
z-m-12-02.goal: Gwada ra'ayin cewa 'yin abu iri ɗaya ga lambar ƙasa da ta sama' yana kiyaye girman kasro, sannan ka bayyana ayyukan da ke kiyaye girman kasro da yanayi na musamman da hanyar Seoa ke aiki.
z-m-12-02.material: Seoa ta rubuta yadda ta sauƙaƙa 4/8 (huɗu cikin takwas). Rage kasro yana nufin rage lambobin ƙasa da sama yayin da girman kasron ya tsaya iri ɗaya. Seoa ta san cewa 'idan aka yi abu iri ɗaya ga lambar ƙasa da ta sama, girman ba ya canzawa.' Mu bincika ko za mu iya amincewa da hanyarta.
z-m-12-02.thinking.0: Gwada ingancin hanya ta amfani da gaskiyar da aka sani.
z-m-12-02.thinking.1: Nemo ikirarin da ba daidai ba a aikin.
z-m-12-02.thinking.2: Nemo sharadin da hanyar ke aiki a cikinsa kawai.
z-m-12-02.prereq.0: Ma'anar kasrori masu girma iri ɗaya (matakin aji na 5).
z-m-12-02.s.s1.prompt: Kana son gwada ko za a iya amincewa da hanyar Seoa. Ta yaya za ka fi tabbatarwa?
z-m-12-02.s.s1.hint.0: Ka yi tunanin kasron da zai sauƙaƙa bincikar sakamakon idan ka gwada hanyar Seoa.
z-m-12-02.s.s1.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin yadda za ka yi amfani da hanyar a kasro mai girman da ka riga ka sani, ka kwatanta sakamakon da girman farko.
z-m-12-02.s.s1.o.a: Zana 4/8 da 2/6 a hoto, ka duba ko suna kama da girma ɗaya.
z-m-12-02.s.s1.r.a: Kama da juna ba hujja ba ce cewa sun yi daidai. Ƙananan bambanci yana da wuya a gani da ido.
z-m-12-02.s.s1.o.b: Yi amfani da hanyar a kasro 2/4 (rabi) da ka san amsarta, ka duba ko ƙimar ta tsaya iri ɗaya.
z-m-12-02.s.s1.r.b: Wannan ra'ayi ne cewa ingancin hanya za a iya bincikawa nan take ta amfani da ita a yanayin da amsa ta riga ta sani.
z-m-12-02.s.s1.o.c: Sake lissafa 8−2 da 4−2 ka duba ko Seoa ta rage daidai.
z-m-12-02.s.s1.r.c: Lissafin daidai ne da hanyar daidai ne abubuwa ne mabambanta.
z-m-12-02.s.s1.o.d: Tunda ta yi 'abu iri ɗaya', hanyar dole ta yi daidai, mu wuce.
z-m-12-02.s.s1.r.d: Ko da an yi abu iri ɗaya ga lambar ƙasa da ta sama, sakamakon na iya canzawa bisa ko ƙari ne, ragi ne, ninkawa ko rabo.
z-m-12-02.s.s1.explain: Idan ka gwada hanyar a kasro da amsarta ka sani, za ka gane nan take ko tana kiyaye girma. 2/4 rabi ne (1/2), amma idan aka rage 1 iri ɗaya, ya zama 1/3, girman ya canza.
z-m-12-02.s.s2.prompt: Seoa ta sauya 4/8 ta hanyoyi biyu ta rubuta haka. Zaɓi layi na farko da ba daidai ba.
z-m-12-02.s.s2.hint.0: Bambanta ko kowane layi yana bayyana sakamakon lissafi ne ko yana ikirarin cewa sakamako biyu daidai suke.
z-m-12-02.s.s2.hint.1: Mayar da 1/2 da 2/6 zuwa lambar ƙasa iri ɗaya ko decimal, ka kwatanta girmansu kai tsaye.
z-m-12-02.s.s2.line.0: Manufa: yin kasro mai girma ɗaya da 4/8 amma lambar ƙasa da ta sama ƙanana.
z-m-12-02.s.s2.line.1: Hanya 가: raba lambar ƙasa da sama da 4 iri ɗaya → 1/2.
z-m-12-02.s.s2.line.2: Hanya 나: rage 2 iri ɗaya daga lambar ƙasa da sama → 2/6.
z-m-12-02.s.s2.line.3: A 가 da 나 duka an yi abu iri ɗaya ga lambar ƙasa da ta sama, don haka 1/2 da 2/6 girma ɗaya suke.
z-m-12-02.s.s2.explain: Layi na 4 ne farkon kuskure (layi na 5 sakamakonsa ne). 'Raba da lamba iri ɗaya' yana kiyaye girman, amma 'rage adadi iri ɗaya' ba ya kiyaye. 4/8=1/2 daidai ne, amma 2/6=1/3, girmansa ya bambanta da 1/2. Layuka na 2 da 3 daidai ne a matsayin lissafi.
z-m-12-02.s.s3.prompt: Shin akwai kasro da girmansa ba ya canzawa ko da an yi hanyar Seoa (rage lamba k iri ɗaya daga ƙasa da sama)? Zaɓi kasro a/b da adadin k da za a rage, ta yadda (a−k)/(b−k) zai yi girma ɗaya da a/b, nemo misalai mabambanta guda 3 ka shigar. (a da b cikakkun lambobi ne daga 2 zuwa 12, k cikakkiyar lamba ce daga 1 zuwa 11, kuma a da b dole su fi k.)
z-m-12-02.s.s3.hint.0: Zaɓi kasro ɗaya da lambar da za a rage, ka lissafa, sannan ka mayar da sakamakon da na asali zuwa decimal ka kwatanta.
z-m-12-02.s.s3.hint.1: Tara misalan da suka yi daidai a tebur, ka kwatanta a da b gefe da gefe.
z-m-12-02.s.s3.var.k: Lambar da za a rage k.
z-m-12-02.s.s3.fail.c1: Shigar da a, b, k a matsayin cikakkun lambobi.
z-m-12-02.s.s3.fail.c2: a da b su kasance daga 2 zuwa 12, k kuma daga 1 zuwa 11.
z-m-12-02.s.s3.ok.c3: a da b duka sun fi k.
z-m-12-02.s.s3.fail.c3: Dole a da b su fi k domin su ci gaba da zama kasro bayan ragi.
z-m-12-02.s.s3.ok.c4: Girman kafin da bayan ragi iri ɗaya ne.
z-m-12-02.s.s3.fail.c4: Girman bayan ragi ya bambanta. Nemo ƙimar kasrorin kai tsaye ko mayar da su decimal ka kwatanta.

z-m-12-01.title: Shin ninkar gutsure biyu koyaushe tana samar da lamba mafi girma?
z-m-12-01.goal: Gwada ko ikirarin ‘ninkawa tana sa ya fi girma’ yana aiki ga gutsure ta ƙirƙirar misalai, sannan ka bayyana cewa girman samfurin ya danganta da ko lambobin da aka ninka sun fi ko sun yi ƙasa da 1.
z-m-12-01.material: Hayun ta ce, ‘Ninkawa ƙara lamba iri ɗaya sau da dama ce, saboda haka idan aka ninka gutsure biyu, sakamakon dole ya fi gutsuren biyu. Misali, idan aka ninka 2/3 (biyu bisa uku) da 3/4 (uku bisa huɗu), za a samu lamba mafi girma fiye da 2/3 ko 3/4.’ A nan duk gutsure sun fi 0, kuma ka riga ka san yadda ake ninka gutsure.
z-m-12-01.thinking.0: Shakkar ko tunanin lambobi cikakku zai yi aiki ga gutsure ma
z-m-12-01.thinking.1: Gwada ikirari ta ƙirƙirar misalan karya da kanka
z-m-12-01.thinking.2: Gano sharadin da ke sauya sakamako
z-m-12-01.s.s1.prompt: Kana son gano ko furucin Hayun gaskiya ne a kowane yanayi. Wane mataki na farko ne ya fi dogaro?
z-m-12-01.s.s1.hint.0: Gano darajar misalin Hayun 2/3 × 3/4, jera kusa da 2/3 da 3/4, ka duba wanne ya fi girma.
z-m-12-01.s.s1.hint.1: Zaɓi ƙarin ma’aurata biyu na gutsure ka gwada haka. Rubuta a tebur ko kowane sakamako ya fi ko ya yi ƙasa da lambobin da aka ninka.
z-m-12-01.s.s1.o.a: Ninkar lambobi cikakku ta ba da 3×4=12, wanda ya fi girma, saboda haka gaskiya ne ga gutsure ma.
z-m-12-01.s.s1.r.a: Ka miƙa ƙa’idar lambobi cikakku kai tsaye ga gutsure. Za ka san ko haka yake ga gutsure ne kawai idan ka gwada su dabam.
z-m-12-01.s.s1.o.b: Ninkawa tana sa abu ya fi girma, don haka tabbas ne ba sai an gwada ba.
z-m-12-01.s.s1.r.b: Idan ka tsaya kan ma’anar da aka saba kawai, ba za ka sami damar neman abin da ya saba da ƙa’ida ba.
z-m-12-01.s.s1.o.c: Ninka ma’auratan gutsure da dama ka kwatanta kowane sakamako da gutsuren biyu.
z-m-12-01.s.s1.r.c: Don gwada ‘koyaushe’, dole ka ƙirƙiri misalai da dama sannan ka kwatanta kowane sakamako ɗaya bayan ɗaya da lambobin da ka ninka.
z-m-12-01.s.s1.o.d: Sake gwada yadda ake ninka gutsure don kada kuskuren lissafi ya faru.
z-m-12-01.s.s1.r.d: Yin lissafi daidai da gwada ko ikirari gaskiya ne koyaushe abubuwa biyu ne daban.
z-m-12-01.s.s1.explain: Idan ikirari ya ce ‘koyaushe’, gwaji mafi kai tsaye shi ne ninka gutsure da dama ka kwatanta kowane sakamako da lambobin da aka ninka. Daidai ga lambobi cikakku ba ya nufin daidai ga gutsure.
z-m-12-01.s.s2.prompt: Yi misalan da maganar Hayun ba gaskiya ba ce. Idan ka ninka kasrori a/b da c/d (lambobin sama da na ƙasa cikakkun lambobi ne daga 1 zuwa 12), nemo misalai 3 da samfurinsu ya gaza a/b kuma ya gaza c/d, samfurorin kuma su bambanta, ka shigar da su.
z-m-12-01.s.s2.hint.0: Zaɓi kasrori biyu, ka ninka su, ka kwatanta samfurin da kowanne daga cikin kasrorin biyun ɗaya bayan ɗaya don ganin ko ya fi ko ya gaza.
z-m-12-01.s.s2.hint.1: Idan samfurin ya fi girma, canza kasrorin. Jera misalan da sakamakonsu ya gaza da waɗanda ya fi girma gefe da gefe, ka duba kasrorin da ka ninka.
z-m-12-01.s.s2.hint.2: A misalan da sakamakonsu ya gaza, kwatanta kowanne daga cikin kasrorin da ka ninka da 1.
z-m-12-01.s.s2.ok.c1: Lambar sama da ta ƙasa duka aƙalla 1 ne.
z-m-12-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Lambar sama da ta ƙasa dole duka su zama aƙalla 1.
z-m-12-01.s.s2.ok.c2: Lambar sama da ta ƙasa ba su fi 12 ba.
z-m-12-01.s.s2.fail.c2: A kiyaye lambobin sama da na ƙasa su kasance 12 ko ƙasa da haka.
z-m-12-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Shigar da lambobin sama da ƙasa a matsayin cikakkun lambobi.
z-m-12-01.s.s2.ok.c4: Samfurin ya gaza kasrorin biyun duka.
z-m-12-01.s.s2.fail.c4: Samfurin bai gaza ɗaya daga cikin kasrorin ba. Ci gaba da canza kasrorin da ka ninka, ka kwatanta samfurin da kasrorin biyun ɗaya bayan ɗaya.
z-m-12-01.s.s2.explain: Misali, 2/3 × 3/4 = 6/12 = 1/2, kuma 1/2 ya gaza 2/3 da 3/4 duka. Haka ma 1/2 × 1/3 = 1/6 da 3/5 × 2/7 = 6/35. Idan kasrorin biyun sun gaza 1, kamar ɗaukar 'ɓangare' na 'ɓangare na lamba' ne, saboda haka sakamakon ya gaza lambobin biyun.
z-m-12-01.s.s3.prompt: Me za ka faɗa wa Hayun? Bayyana yanayin da samfurin ya gaza lambobin da aka ninka da kuma lokacin da ya fi girma, da misalan lambobi; idan akwai yanayin da ra'ayin Hayun ya yi daidai, rubuta sharadin ma.
z-m-12-01.s.s3.hint.0: Za ka iya amfani da misalan da ka yi a sama. Rubuta ko kowace kasrar da ka ninka ta fi ko ta gaza 1.
z-m-12-01.s.s3.hint.1: Yi da hannu misali ɗaya ga kowanne: ninka kasrori biyu da suka fi 1, da kasra mai fiye da 1 da wadda ta gaza 1; ka kwatanta.
z-m-12-01.s.s3.placeholder: Misali, idan kasrorin biyun sun gaza 1, ...
z-m-12-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka nuna ta hanyar kwatanta samfurin kai tsaye da kasrorin a misalanka?
z-m-12-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka faɗi cewa sakamakon yana canzawa bisa ko lambobin da aka ninka sun fi ko sun gaza 1?
z-m-12-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka gano aƙalla yanayi ɗaya (sharadi) da maganar Hayun take daidai?
z-m-12-01.s.s3.model.0: Idan kasrorin biyun sun gaza 1, samfurin ya gaza lambobin biyun. Misali 2/3 × 3/4=1/2. A gefe guda, idan duka sun fi 1, kamar 3/2 × 5/4=15/8, samfurin ya fi lambobin biyun. Idan ɗaya ce kawai ta fi 1, kamar 3/2 × 1/2=3/4, sakamakon yana tsakanin lambobin biyun.
z-m-12-01.s.s3.model.1: Maganar Hayun ba koyaushe gaskiya ba ce. 3/4×1/2=3/8 ya gaza lambobin biyun. Amma idan lambar da ake ninkawa da ita ta fi 1, sakamakon na iya ƙaruwa. 2/3×3/2=1 ya fi 2/3 girma amma ya gaza 3/2.
z-m-12-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Amsa da ta yi amfani da kasrori marasa dacewa maimakon lambobi gauraye ma ta dace.

z-m-12-03.title: Mira ta duba misalai uku. Shin wannan ya isa?
z-m-12-03.topic: Siffofin ninkin lambobi: haɗa ninkin lambobi mabambanta.
z-m-12-03.goal: Ka fahimci cewa ƴan misalai na gaskiya ba sa nuna cewa 'dole gaskiya ne'; ka ƙirƙiri misalai masu karyatawa, ka nemo abin da za a iya faɗi koyaushe game da jimillar ninkin 4 da ninkin 6, ka bayyana dalili.
z-m-12-03.material: Mira ta ce, 'Idan aka haɗa ninkin 4 da ninkin 6, jimillar dole ta zama ninkin 4 ko ninkin 6.' Mira ta gwada yanayi uku: 8+12=20 (ninkin 4), 12+6=18 (ninkin 6), 24+12=36 (ninkin 4 da 6 duka). A nan lambobi duk cikakkun lambobi ne har zuwa 60.
z-m-12-03.thinking.0: Bambanta 'misalan gaskiya ne' da 'koyaushe gaskiya ne'.
z-m-12-03.thinking.1: Yi misalai masu karyatawa da suka cika sharudda.
z-m-12-03.thinking.2: Nemo siffar da kullum take gaskiya da dalilinta.
z-m-12-03.prereq.0: Ma'anar ninkin lamba da raba lamba (matakin aji na 5).
z-m-12-03.prereq.1: Jera ninkin lambobi biyu domin bincika.
z-m-12-03.s.s1.prompt: Mira tana tunanin maganarta daidai ce domin misalai ukun sun yi aiki. Wace hanya ce ta fi dacewa a ɗauki wannan yanayi?
z-m-12-03.s.s1.hint.0: Duba abin da Mira ta zaɓa a matsayin ninkin 4 da ninkin 6 a misalanta ukun.
z-m-12-03.s.s1.hint.1: Yi ƙarin misalai kaɗan da suka bambanta da na Mira, ka rubuta ninkin wace lamba jimillar ta zama.
z-m-12-03.s.s1.o.a: Dukkansu ukun sun yi daidai, saboda haka za mu iya ɗaukar wannan magana a matsayin daidai.
z-m-12-03.s.s1.r.a: Samun misalai kaɗan na gaskiya ba ya tabbatar da cewa 'dole gaskiya ne'.
z-m-12-03.s.s1.o.b: Idan muka gwada kusan misalai goma na ƙari duka suka yi daidai, za mu iya cewa tabbas gaskiya ne.
z-m-12-03.s.s1.r.b: Ko da ƙarin misalai, ba ka gwada 'kowane yanayi' ba. Ba ka sami misali mara daidai ba tukuna kawai.
z-m-12-03.s.s1.o.c: Lambobin ƙanana ne wataƙila, saboda haka kwatsam suka yi aiki. Sake gwadawa da lambobi manya sosai kawai.
z-m-12-03.s.s1.r.c: Matsalar ba girman lambobi ba ce, yadda aka zaɓi misalan ne. Za ka iya tattara misalai na gaskiya kawai ko da lambobin manya ne.
z-m-12-03.s.s1.o.d: Idan an ce 'dole', ya kamata ka nemi misali da gangan da zai kasa, guda ɗaya ya isa.
z-m-12-03.s.s1.r.d: Wannan ra'ayi ne cewa maimakon tara misalai na gaskiya, ya kamata a nemi yanayin da zai iya kasa a gwada shi da gangan.
z-m-12-03.s.s1.explain: Kalmar 'dole' za ta karye da misali guda mara daidai. Neman yanayin da zai iya kasa da gangan hanya ce kai tsaye ta yanke hukunci fiye da tara misalai na gaskiya.
z-m-12-03.s.s2.prompt: Yi misalan da maganar Mira ba gaskiya ba ce. Haɗa A, ninkin 4, da B, ninkin 6 (dukkansu cikakkun lambobi ne har zuwa 60), ta yadda A+B ba ninkin 4 ba ne kuma ba ninkin 6 ba; nemo misalai 3 masu jimilloli mabambanta ka shigar.
z-m-12-03.s.s2.hint.0: Haɗa mafi ƙaramin ninkin 4 da mafi ƙaramin ninkin 6, nemo jimilla ka duba ko ana raba ta da 4 ko 6.
z-m-12-03.s.s2.hint.1: Idan ana iya raba ta, canza A ko B ɗaya bayan ɗaya, ka rubuta a tebur yadda jimillar ke canzawa.
z-m-12-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Shigar da A da B a matsayin cikakkun lambobi daga 1 zuwa 60.
z-m-12-03.s.s2.ok.c4: Jimillar ba ninkin 4 ba ce, ba kuma ninkin 6 ba.
z-m-12-03.s.s2.fail.c4: Jimillar ninkin 4 ce ko ninkin 6. Canza A da B zuwa wasu, ka sake duba jimillar.
z-m-12-03.s.s2.explain: Misali, 4+6=10 ba ya rabewa da 4 ko 6. Haka ma 8+6=14, 4+18=22, 20+6=26. Saboda haka maganar Mira ba 'dole gaskiya' ba ce.
z-m-12-03.s.s3.prompt: Idan aka duba duk misalan da ka samu tare da na Mira, akwai abu guda da za ka iya faɗa tabbas game da A+B. Rubuta shi, ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa yake koyaushe.
z-m-12-03.s.s3.hint.0: Rubuta duk jimilloli, ka duba ɗaya bayan ɗaya ko akwai lambar da ke raba su duka.
z-m-12-03.s.s3.hint.1: Raba ninkin 4 da ninkin 6 zuwa ƙungiyoyi masu girma iri ɗaya, ka nemo girman ƙungiyar da lambobin biyu suke da shi tare.
z-m-12-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka rubuta a sarari siffa guda da jimillar take da ita koyaushe?
z-m-12-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka bayyana dalilin ta amfani da abin da ninkin 4 da ninkin 6 suke da shi iri ɗaya?
z-m-12-03.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka rubuta kana sane cewa jimillar ba koyaushe ninkin 4 ko ninkin 6 ba ce?
z-m-12-03.s.s3.model.0: Koyaushe ninkin 2 ce (lamba mai-cika-biyu). Ninkin 4 da ninkin 6 duka lambobi masu-cika-biyu ne, jimillar lambobi masu-cika-biyu kuma mai-cika-biyu ce. Kamar 4+6=10 da 8+6=14, duka masu-cika-biyu ne ko da ba ninkin 4 ko 6 ba.
z-m-12-03.s.s3.model.1: 4 da 6 duka ninkin 2 ne, saboda haka ana iya raba ninkin 4 da na 6 gida-gida na 2. Idan aka haɗa abubuwan da aka tsara gida-gida na 2, sakamakon ma zai kasance gida-gida na 2, saboda haka jimillar koyaushe ninkin 2 ce. 2 lamba ce da ke raba 4 da 6 duka.

z-m-12-04.title: Wace lamba ce ke zuwa bayan 1,2,4? Lambobin: 1, 2, 4, 8.
z-m-12-04.topic: Nemo ƙa'idar tsarin lambobi da iyakokinta.
z-m-12-04.goal: Duba yadda amincin faɗin lamba ta gaba bisa ƙa'idar da aka gano daga lambobi farko yake, sake duba amincewa bisa sabon bayani, ka faɗi ƙarin abin da ake buƙata don amincewa da ƙa'ida.
z-m-12-04.material: Ana jera lambobi bisa ƙa'ida. Lambobi uku na farko 1, 2, 4 ne. Ana yin ƙa'idar daga lambobin da aka riga aka sanya kawai, a ɗauka cewa ƙa'ida ɗaya ce ke ci gaba har ƙarshe. Yi hukunci da lambobin kawai ba tare da hoto ba.
z-m-12-04.thinking.0: Kwatanta ƙa'idoji da dama da suka dace da bayanai iri ɗaya.
z-m-12-04.thinking.1: Sake duba hukunci da amincewa yayin da sabon bayani ya zo.
z-m-12-04.thinking.2: Faɗin bayanin da ake buƙata domin amincewa da ƙa'ida.
z-m-12-04.prereq.0: Nemo ƙa'ida a tsarin lambobi (matakin aji na 4 zuwa 5).
z-m-12-04.prereq.1: Duba bambancin lambobin maƙwabta da alaƙar ninkin lambobi.
z-m-12-04.s.s1.prompt: Ana bayyana lamba guda ƙari kowane lokaci. Kowace dama zaɓi lambar da za ta biyo baya.
z-m-12-04.s.s1.hint.0: A kowane mataki, gwada ɗaya bayan ɗaya ko ƙa'idar ta dace da duk lambobin da aka sani zuwa yanzu.
z-m-12-04.s.s1.hint.1: Rubuta a tebur wuraren da ƙa'idoji biyu suka ba da ƙima ɗaya da wurin farko da suka bambanta, ka kwatanta.
z-m-12-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Lambobi uku na farko a tsarin su ne 1, 2, 4.
z-m-12-04.s.s1.st.0.after: 7 da 8 duka suna da ƙa'idodin da suka dace da 1, 2, 4 (ƙa'idar bambanci yana ƙaruwa 1,2,3 da ninkawa sau 2). Lambobi ukun kaɗai ba su takaita ƙa'idar zuwa guda ɗaya ba. 6 bai dace da tsarin daga 1 zuwa 2 ba. Lambobin: 1, 2, 4, 8.
z-m-12-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: 6: Ƙa'idar ƙara 2 iri ɗaya kowane lokaci.
z-m-12-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ya ƙaru da 1 daga 1 zuwa 2, da 2 daga 2 zuwa 4. Ba ka duba ko ƙa'ida ɗaya ta dace tsakanin lambobin biyu na farko ba.
z-m-12-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: 7: Ƙa'idar ita ce adadin da ake ƙara yana ƙaruwa da ɗaya kowane lokaci: 1,2,3. Lambobin: 1, 2, 4, 8.
z-m-12-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wannan ra'ayi ne na lura da yadda bambancin lambobi ke canzawa. Ƙa'ida ce da ta dace da 1,2,4. Lambobin: 1, 2, 4, 8.
z-m-12-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wannan ra'ayi ne na lura da alaƙar ninkawa tsakanin lamba da wadda ke biyo baya. Ƙa'ida ce da ta dace da 1,2,4. Lambobin: 1, 2, 4, 8.
z-m-12-04.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Ba za a iya yanke shawara ba: ƙa'idoji fiye da ɗaya sun dace da lambobi ukun.
z-m-12-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Wannan ra'ayi ne na fara tambayar ko bayanai sun kayyade ƙa'ida guda ɗaya.
z-m-12-04.s.s1.st.1.info: An bayyana lamba ta huɗu: 1,2,4,8. Lambobin: 1, 2, 4, 8.
z-m-12-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Ƙa'idar ƙarin lambar da ke ƙaruwa da ɗaya ba ta dace da 8 ba, saboda haka an cire ta. Ƙa'idar ninka lambar baya da 2 ta dace da lambobi huɗun, tana ba da 16. Amma wannan ita ce ƙa'ida 'mafi yiwuwa'; ba ka san dalili ba tukuna.
z-m-12-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: 16: ƙa'idar ninka lambar baya da 2 ta dace da duk lambobi huɗun.
z-m-12-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ka zaɓi ƙa’ida da ta dace da lambobi huɗu, ka yi hasashen lamba ta gaba.
z-m-12-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: 11: ƙa’idar ita ce adadin da aka ƙara yana ƙaruwa da 1 kowane lokaci: 1 2 3 4.

z-m-12-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wannan tunani ne mai taka-tsantsan cewa ko ƙa’ida ta dace da lambobi huɗu, wata ƙa’ida dabam na iya kasancewa.
z-m-12-04.s.s1.st.1.o.d: 12: a mataki na ƙarshe an ƙara 4, saboda haka daga yanzu za mu ƙara 4 kullum.
z-m-12-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Ka duba na ƙarshe kawai ba tare da duba ɓangaren baya inda adadin ƙarin ya canza 1 2 4 ba.
z-m-12-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Waɗannan su ne mafi yawan sassan da za a iya samu a cikin da’ira idan an yi maki a kan gefen da’irar sannan aka haɗa duk maki da layukan miƙe. z-m-12-08.s.s2.prompt: Jisu ta gano kewayar siffar da ta rage kamar haka. Zaɓi layi guda da ba daidai ba.
z-m-12-08.s.s2.hint.0: Bi iyakar siffar da ta rage da yatsa zagaye ɗaya, ka rubuta duk gefunan da ka wuce.
z-m-12-08.s.s2.hint.1: Jera gefunan da Jisu ta ƙirga da waɗanda ka rubuta ta bin iyaka, ka gano ko akwai gefen da aka manta.
z-m-12-08.s.s2.line.1: Zagaya siffar da ta rage ka ƙirga gefuna. Ƙasa 10, hagu 8, sama 6 (=10−4).
z-m-12-08.s.s2.line.2: Bayan gefen sama, bi ƙasa 3 ta gefen wurin da aka yanke, dama 4, sannan ƙasa 5 (=8−3), ka dawo wurin farawa.
z-m-12-08.s.s2.line.3: Amma 3 da 4 gefuna ne da suka zurfafa ciki, saboda haka a cire su daga kewaya. Kewayarta 10+8+6+5=29 (cm).
z-m-12-08.s.s2.line.4: Kewayar ta gajarta da 7 cm idan aka kwatanta da asalin 36 cm.
z-m-12-08.s.s2.explain: Layi na 4 ne ba daidai ba (layi na 5 sakamakonsa ne). Gefen da ya zurfafa ciki ma ɓangaren iyakar siffa ne, dole a ƙirga shi a kewaya. 10+8+6+3+4+5=36 (cm), iri ɗaya da ta farko.
z-m-12-08.s.s3.prompt: A wannan karon, a wannan takarda (faɗin 10 cm, tsawon 8 cm), kusa da tsakiyar gefen sama amma a bar kusurwoyin biyu, a yanke gurbi mai siffar murabba’i mai faɗin p cm da zurfin q cm. Nemo gurabe 3 daban-daban da za su sa kewaya ta ƙaru aƙalla 8 cm sama da ta farko, filin da ya rage kuma aƙalla 50 cm², ka rubuta su. (p lambar halitta ce 1 zuwa 8, q kuma 1 zuwa 7.)
z-m-12-08.s.s3.hint.0: Zaɓi gurbi, zagaya siffar da ta rage ka rubuta kewaya, sannan ka kwatanta da 36 cm.
z-m-12-08.s.s3.hint.1: Rubuta a tebur ko kewaya ko fili da ya rage ke canzawa idan ka sauya q ko p.
z-m-12-08.s.s3.fail.c1: Shigar da p da q a matsayin lambobi na halitta.
z-m-12-08.s.s3.ok.c2: p da q suna cikin zangon.
z-m-12-08.s.s3.fail.c2: p dole ya kasance 1 zuwa 8, q kuma 1 zuwa 7.
z-m-12-08.s.s3.fail.c3: Kewaya ba ta ƙaru aƙalla 8 cm ba. Duba zurfin gurbi da canjin kewaya.
z-m-12-08.s.s3.ok.c4: Filin da ya rage aƙalla 50 cm² ne.
z-m-12-08.s.s3.fail.c4: Filin da ya rage bai kai 50 cm² ba. Duba filin da aka yanke.
z-m-12-08.s.s3.explain: Zurfin gurbi q ne ke ƙayyade kewaya (saboda sabon gefen gurbi biyu sun bayyana, kewaya tana ƙaruwa da 2×q cm), samfurin faɗin gurbi p da zurfinsa q kuma ke ƙayyade filin da ya ɓace. Misali idan p=6, q=4, filin da ya rage 80−24=56 cm², kewaya kuma 36+2×4=44 cm.
z-m-12-08.s.s3.because.prompt: Idan aka yanke kusurwa, kewaya ta tsaya yadda take. Me ya sa take ƙaruwa idan aka yanke tsakiyar gefen sama? Faɗi waɗanne gefunan gurbi ne sababbi a kewaya.
z-m-12-08.s.s3.because.hint.0: Ga kowane yanayi biyu, rubuta gefunan da suka ɓace da waɗanda suka bayyana.
z-m-12-08.s.s3.because.hint.1: Nemo gefen gurbi da ya maye gurbin gefen da yake kan iyaka tun farko.
z-m-12-08.s.s3.because.placeholder: Misali: Idan ka yanke kusurwa ... Idan tsakiyar ...
z-m-12-08.s.s3.because.selfAssess.0: Shin ka kwatanta yadda sababbin gefuna suka bambanta tsakanin kusurwa da tsakiya?
z-m-12-08.s.s3.because.selfAssess.1: Shin ka faɗi cewa tsawon da ya ƙaru yana da alaƙa da zurfin gurbi?
z-m-12-08.s.s3.because.model.0: Idan aka yanke kusurwa, gefen sama 4 da gefen dama 3 da suka ɓace an maye gurbinsu da ƙasan gurbi 4 da gefensa 3, saboda haka kewaya ba ta canzawa. Amma idan aka yanke tsakiya, ɓangare ɗaya na gefen sama ne kawai ke ɓacewa, gefuna biyu da ƙasan gurbin kuma sababbi ne, saboda haka kewaya tana ƙaruwa. Ƙarin tsawon sau biyu zurfin ne.
z-m-12-08.s.s3.because.model.1: Idan ka yanke tsakiyar, sababbin gefunan gurbi biyu (zurfin q) sun bayyana sun ƙara tsawo. Ƙasan gurbi daidai yake da ɓangaren gefen sama da ya ɓace, don haka sun maye gurbin juna. A kusurwa, gefen gurbi ɗaya ya maye gurbin gefen da yake akwai, saboda haka ba ya ƙaruwa.

z-m-12-09.title: Idan aka haɗa matsakaicin rukuni biyu, zai zama tsakiyar daidai?
z-m-12-09.topic: Tasirin yawan mutane yayin haɗa matsakaicin rukuni biyu
z-m-12-09.goal: Fahimtar cewa ko da matsakaitan rukuni biyu an sani, matsakaicin gaba ɗaya yana danganta da yawan mutane; ƙirƙiri ma’auratan girman rukuni da suka cika sharudda da kanka, sannan bayyana lokacin da tsakiyar yake matsakaicin gaba ɗaya da lokacin da ba haka ba.
z-m-12-09.material: Rukuni 가 da rukuni 나 sun warware tambayoyin lissafi iri ɗaya. Matsakaicin rukuni 가 maki 80 ne, na rukuni 나 maki 70. Kana son haɗa makin ɗaliban rukunonin biyu ka gano ‘matsakaicin gaba ɗaya’. Hyeonu ya ce, ‘Tsakiyar matsakaitan maki 80 da 70, wato maki 75, ita ce matsakaicin gaba ɗaya.’ Dukkan makin na jarrabawa iri ɗaya ne.

z-m-12-09.thinking.1: Samar da ma’aurata da dama na girman rukuni da suka cika sharudda
z-m-12-09.thinking.2: Bayyana dalilin da ya sa matsakaici ke shafar yawan mutane
z-m-12-09.prereq.1: Gano jimilla daga matsakaici da yawan bayanai
z-m-12-09.s.s1.prompt: Rukuni 가 yana da ɗalibai 6, rukuni 나 kuma 4. Wane hukunci ne ya fi dacewa game da matsakaicin gaba ɗaya?
z-m-12-09.s.s1.hint.0: Yi tunanin yawan ɗaliban da kowanne rukuni 가 da 나 zai buƙata don a ƙidaya maki da nauyi iri ɗaya.
z-m-12-09.s.s1.hint.1: Tantance ko za a iya gano jimillar makin rukuni daga matsakaici da yawan ɗalibai.
z-m-12-09.s.s1.o.a: Ya fi maki 75. Domin akwai ƙarin ɗalibai a rukunin maki 80.
z-m-12-09.s.s1.r.a: Wannan tunani ne da ya lura cewa makin rukunin da ke da ɗalibai da yawa suna da ƙarin tasiri.
z-m-12-09.s.s1.o.b: Maki 75 ne daidai. Domin tsakiyar maki 80 da 70 ne.
z-m-12-09.s.s1.r.b: Ka duba matsakaita kawai ba yawan mutane ba. Duba ko har yanzu tsakiyar ne idan adadin mutane ya bambanta.
z-m-12-09.s.s1.o.c: Ya yi ƙasa da maki 75. Domin rukunin mai ƙaramin maki yana ja da matsakaicin ƙasa.
z-m-12-09.s.s1.r.c: Gaskiya ne ƙananan maki suna ja da matsakaici ƙasa, amma ka manta cewa wannan rukuni yana da ƙarancin mutane, saboda haka tasirinsa ƙanƙanta ne.
z-m-12-09.s.s1.o.d: Ba za mu iya sani ba domin ba mu san makin kowane ɗalibi ba.
z-m-12-09.s.s1.r.d: Idan ka san matsakaicin rukuni da yawan mutane, za ka iya gano jimillar makin rukuni; saboda haka matsakaicin gaba ɗaya tabbatacce ne ko da ba a san makin ɗaiɗaikun ba.
z-m-12-09.s.s1.explain: Jimillar makin rukuni 가 ita ce 80×6=480, na rukuni 나 kuma 70×4=280, saboda haka jimilla 760 ce ga ɗalibai 10, matsakaicin gaba ɗaya kuma maki 76 ne. Ya fi kusa da matsakaicin rukunin da ke da ɗalibai da yawa.

(n da m lambobi ne na halitta daga 1 zuwa 20.)

z-m-12-09.s.s2.hint.1: Jera ma’auratan da suka ba da maki 76 a tebur, ka gano alaƙar n da m.

z-m-12-10.title: Tsara akwatin ƙwallo: adadin ƙwallo guda ɗaya ne kawai zai cika sharudda?
z-m-12-10.topic: Kwatanta yiwuwar faruwa da fassara sakamakon gwaji
z-m-12-10.goal: Tantance adadin ƙwallo ta hanyoyi da dama don cika sharuddan yiwuwar zana kowanne, sannan bayyana cewa ba za a iya cewa ƙira ba daidai ba ce kawai saboda sakamakon gwaji mai ƙoƙari kaɗan ya bambanta.
z-m-12-10.material: Ƙungiyar Mina ta saka ƙwallaye ja, shuɗi, da rawaya cikin akwati, suka rufe ido suka ɗauki ƙwallo, suka duba launinta, suka mayar, suna gaurayawa. Ƙwallayen girmansu da nauyinsu iri ɗaya ne kuma an gauraya sosai, don haka kowace ƙwallo tana da yiwuwar fitowa iri ɗaya. Sharuddan ƙirar akwatin: jan ƙwallo lallai ya ninka rawaya sau 3. Shuɗi ya kai adadin rawaya ko ya fi, amma ya yi ƙasa da ja. A saka aƙalla ƙwallo 1 na kowane launi uku, jimillar kuma daga 10 zuwa 24.
z-m-12-10.thinking.0: Mayar da sharuddan yiwuwa zuwa lambobi don samar da mafita da dama
z-m-12-10.thinking.2: Gyara kuskuren tunanin cewa sakamakon baya yana sauya yiwuwar gaba
z-m-12-10.prereq.0: Kwatanta yiwuwar faruwa da kalmomi (aji na 5)
z-m-12-10.prereq.1: Launin da ke da ƙwallaye da yawa ya fi yiwuwa a zana.
z-m-12-10.s.s1.prompt: Ƙirƙiri tsarin akwati 3 daban-daban da suka cika sharudda. Shigar da adadin ƙwallaye ja, shuɗi, da rawaya.
z-m-12-10.s.s1.hint.0: Da zarar ka zaɓi adadin rawaya, adadin ja ya ƙayyade. Gwada adadin rawaya da zai sa jimillar ta kasance cikin zangon.
z-m-12-10.s.s1.hint.1: Bayan ka zaɓi ja da rawaya, duba zangon adadin shuɗi tsakanin lambobin biyun sannan ka daidaita jimillar.
z-m-12-10.s.s1.ok.c1: Kowane launi uku lamba ce ta halitta aƙalla 1.
z-m-12-10.s.s1.fail.c1: Shigar da lamba ta halitta aƙalla 1 ga duk launuka ukun.
z-m-12-10.s.s1.ok.c2: Jan ƙwallaye su ne sau 3 na rawaya.
z-m-12-10.s.s1.fail.c2: Adadin jan ƙwallaye ba sau 3 na rawaya ba ne.
z-m-12-10.s.s1.ok.c3: Shuɗi ya kai adadin rawaya ko ya fi, kuma ya yi ƙasa da ja.
z-m-12-10.s.s1.fail.c3: Adadin shuɗi dole ya kai adadin rawaya ko ya fi, amma ya yi ƙasa da ja.
z-m-12-10.s.s1.ok.c4: Jimillar ƙwallo aƙalla 10 amma ba fiye da 24 ba.
z-m-12-10.s.s1.fail.c4: Jimillar ƙwallaye ba ta tsakanin 10 da 24 ba. Sauya adadin rawaya ka duba jimilla.
z-m-12-10.s.s1.explain: Rawaya 2, 3, ko 4 mai yiwuwa ce. Misali, (ja, shuɗi, rawaya)=(6 2 2) yana da jimilla 10; 6=3×2, 2≥2, 2<6. (6 5 2), (9 4 3), da (12 6 4) ma sun yi. Idan rawaya 1 ce, jimilla ba ta kai 10 ba; idan 5 ko fiye, ta wuce 24.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.prompt: Mina ta ƙera akwati mai ja 6, shuɗi 2, rawaya 2, ta zana sau 10, ja ya fito sau 5, rawaya 3, shuɗi 2. Domin ja bai ninka rawaya sau 3 ba, Mina tana tunanin ƙirar ba daidai ba ce. Wace hanya ce mafi dacewa ta duba?
z-m-12-10.s.s2.hint.0: Jera sakamakon zane sau 10 kusa da adadin cikin akwati (6 2 2), ka faɗi kamanceceniya da bambanci.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.hint.1: Yi tunanin ko sake zana sau 10 daga akwati ɗaya zai ba da sakamako iri ɗaya daidai, sannan ka kwatanta zagayen biyun.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.o.a: Ƙirar ba daidai ba ce. Idan ƙwallo 6 2 2 ne, adadin da aka zana ma dole ya zama 6 2 2.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.r.a: Ka yi tunanin rabon ƙwallayen dole ya bayyana daidai a yawan fitowarsu.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.o.b: Ƙirar daidai ce. Domin rawaya ta fito kaɗan, rawaya ce za ta fi yiwuwa ta fito gaba.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.r.b: Idan aka mayar da ƙwallo aka gauraya, sakamakon baya ba ya sauya yiwuwar gaba, amma ka yi tunanin yana sauyawa.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.o.c: Zane sau 10 kaɗan ne, sakamakon na iya karkata. Ƙara yawan zane, maimaita sau da yawa, sannan ka kwatanta.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.r.c: Wannan tunani ne na ganin cewa sakamakon ƙoƙari kaɗan na iya karkacewa bisa sa’a, a gwada ta ƙara yawan ƙoƙari.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.o.d: Ja ta fi fitowa, saboda haka an tabbatar ƙirar daidai ce.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.r.d: Ka tabbatar da ƙirar daga sakamakon gwaji guda ɗaya.
z-m-12-10.s.s2.explain: Yiwuwar jan ƙwallo ta ninka rawaya sau 3 yana nufin damar fitowarta sau 3 ce, ba cewa za ta fito daidai sau 3 fiye (sau 6 da 2) cikin zane 10 ba. Idan ƙoƙari kaɗan ne, sa’a na iya karkatar da sakamako; yawan gwadawa yana sa sakamakon ya kusanto rabon adadin ƙwallo gabaɗaya. Ja sau 5 da rawaya sau 3 sakamako ne da zai iya faruwa sosai.
